title: Edmund Hillary's birth chart
metaDescription: Edmund Hillary's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 26.3° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Cancer — the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 26.3° of Cancer is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 23.0° Leo, Venus holds 10.8° Virgo, Mars holds 7.6° Cancer — in the old shorthand, thought that arrives already in motion; attraction that grows by reliability; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: the Sun to Jupiter, a conjunction with 0.8° of slack. When two functions occupy one degree, the tradition reads a fusion: neither can act without committing the other. Behind it, Mars conjunction Pluto at 0.9°, and Venus sextile Mars at 3.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. Venus in Virgo at 10.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Cancer at 7.6° is in fall; Jupiter in Cancer at 27.0° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Leo at 27.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives water 5, fire 4, earth 1, and cardinal 5, fixed 3, mutable 2 across the modes. A water emphasis keeps long books: little is forgotten, and nothing is felt only once. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Uranus was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aries for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.0° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 20.5°.
